message: "Txt" is not something a TextItem carries, so it is ignored and the document comes out without whatever it was meant to say. Did you mean "Text"?
"text" is not something a TextItem carries, so it is ignored and the document comes out without whatever it was meant to say. Did you mean "Text"?
The section does not say what language it is written in, so a reader announces it with whatever voice it happens to have. Set Language to a tag such as fr-FR.

This section has no page size, so it is laid out on a sheet of nothing: every column too narrow to divide, one item to a page and the rest thrown away. Give it a Dimension in millimetres - 210 by 297 is A4.
This is shown rather than read, and has no alternative text. Without one a screen reader announces nothing at all.
"Destinataire.Nmo" names nothing in the data the host fills in, so it is printed as written, braces and all. Did you mean "Destinataire.Nom"?
"Prix" names nothing in an entry of Lignes de la facture or in the data the host fills in, so it is printed as written, braces and all.
